description: Size: ridge mean + Gaussian-process (RBF+white, ML-II) correction on ridge residuals

model.formula: y_j = ridge(material one-hot + ln(1 + K N0 t) + no_flow + 5(Rt/R0-1.35)), K N0 = 3.75e-3/s (x0.1 no-flow); Dg, AMD via Hatch-Choate; detection: P_j = beta-binomial rate in (flow, material, aged) -> (flow, material) -> flow regime -> global, a=2
model.notes: Ridge on log Dm, ln sigma_g, log M0 plus a GP (RBF + white noise, ML-II) on ridge residuals; Dg and AMD by Hatch-Choate.
